description: This file contains classes and functions related to recommendation models in Spark's MLlib, including the Rating class, MatrixFactorizationModel class, and ALS training functions.

classes.name: Rating
classes.description: Represents a (user, product, rating) tuple with methods for serialization.

classes.name: MatrixFactorizationModel
classes.description: A model trained by matrix factorization techniques, providing prediction and feature extraction methods.

classes.name: ALS
classes.description: Contains class methods for training ALS models, including standard and implicit feedback variants.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Predicts rating for a given user and product.

methods.name: predictAll
methods.description: Predicts ratings for multiple user-product pairs.

methods.name: recommendUsers
methods.description: Recommends top users for a product.

methods.name: recommendProducts
methods.description: Recommends top products for a user.

methods.name: recommendProductsForUsers
methods.description: Recommends top products for all users.

methods.name: recommendUsersForProducts
methods.description: Recommends top users for all products.

methods.name: rank
methods.description: Returns the rank (number of features) of the model.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a trained model from a specified path.

methods.name: train
methods.description: Trains a matrix factorization model with specified parameters.

methods.name: trainImplicit
methods.description: Trains a matrix factorization model using implicit feedback.
